quote: We evaluate the coherence and visual diversity of semantic clusters derived from each model using human judgment. We design an evaluation task in which annotators are presented with a pair of templates, and randomly vary if the templates are drawn from the same or different semantic clusters. They are asked to evaluate whether the two templates are 1) semantically similar and 2) visually similar.
Human annotators were presented with pairs of images ... they answered two yes/no questions about semantic similarity and visual similarity.
